model_annotations.English: This pie chart visually represents data distributed across three distinct categories labeled “2019,” “2018,” and “2017,” each corresponding to a colored segment: “2019” is shown in blue and accounts for 46.0% (46), “2018” is orange at 33.0% (33), and “2017” is green at 21.0% (21). The chart contains three slices, and each segment clearly displays its percentage and associated numerical value within the slice. The segments appear arranged in descending order of size, with the blue “2019” slice being the largest, followed by the orange “2018” slice, and the green “2017” slice being the smallest. There is no legend or exploded segments; all slices are presented as standard wedges within the circular chart.
model_annotations.German: This pie chart visually represents data segmented by year, showing three distinct categories labeled 2019, 2018, and 2017, each corresponding to a different colored slice: 2019 is blue and accounts for 46.0% (46), 2018 is orange and accounts for 33.0% (33), and 2017 is green and accounts for 21.0% (21). The chart includes percentage labels and numerical counts within each slice, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with the largest blue slice at the top. There is no legend or visual emphasis such as exploded slices, and the chart’s purpose is to compare the proportional contributions of these three years.
